footnote_text: Received in exchange for 9,888,752 shares of Series A Preferred Stock of Avenzo Therapeutics, Inc. ("Legacy Avenzo") pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization, dated as of May 31, 2026, by and among Legacy Avenzo, Farmington Merger Sub, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer ("Merger Sub") and the Issuer (the "Merger Agreement"). || Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, on November 20, 2026, Merger Sub merged with and into Legacy Avenzo (the "Merger"), with Legacy Avenzo surviving the Merger as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Issuer. At the effective time of the Merger, each outstanding share of common stock and preferred stock of Legacy Avenzo, other than shares issued in the concurrent financing and other excluded shares under the Merger Agreement, was converted into the right to receive 0.2611 shares of common stock of the Issuer. Immediately prior to the closing of the Merger, the Issuer effected a reverse stock split at a ratio of one new share for every two shares of common stock of the Issuer. In connection with the Merger, the name of the Issuer was changed from Rallybio Corporation to Avenzo Therapeutics, Inc. || The Reporting Person is the sole managing member of SR One Capital Management, LLC ("SR One Capital Management"), which is the sole general partner of SR One Capital Partners II, LP ("SR One Partners II"). SR One Partners II is the sole general partner of SR One Capital Fund II Aggregator, LP ("SR One Fund II Aggregator"), which is the direct beneficial owner of the securities. The Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership, within the meaning of Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended ("Section 16"), or otherwise of such portion of the securities held by SR One Fund II Aggregator in which the Reporting Person has no pecuniary interest.
